DOHNA_DOHNA_POWER_SQUAD_RULES.title: DohnaDohna Squad
DOHNA_DOHNA_POWER_KUMA_INNATE.title: Kuma · Innate
DOHNA_DOHNA_POWER_KUMA_INNATE.descriptio: Kuma and members behind him have 1 additional Strength.
DOHNA_DOHNA_POWER_KUMA_INNATE.smartDescr: Kuma and members behind him have 1 additional Strength.
DOHNA_DOHNA_POWER_ALYCE_INNATE.title: ALyCE · Innate
DOHNA_DOHNA_POWER_ALYCE_INNATE.descripti: ALyCE deals 4 additional damage per hit to enemies attacked by another member this turn.
DOHNA_DOHNA_POWER_ALYCE_INNATE.smartDesc: ALyCE deals 4 additional damage per hit to enemies attacked by another member this turn.
DOHNA_DOHNA_POWER_ANTENA_INNATE.title: Antena · Innate
DOHNA_DOHNA_POWER_ANTENA_INNATE.descript: The first Attack Antena performs each turn grants other members 1 Dexterity this turn for each enemy hit.
DOHNA_DOHNA_POWER_ANTENA_INNATE.smartDes: The first Attack Antena performs each turn grants other members 1 Dexterity this turn for each enemy hit.
DOHNA_DOHNA_POWER_TORA_INNATE.title: Torataro · Innate
DOHNA_DOHNA_POWER_TORA_INNATE.descriptio: Each turn, each kind of positive effect grants Torataro 1 Strength for that turn, once per kind.
DOHNA_DOHNA_POWER_TORA_INNATE.smartDescr: Each turn, each kind of positive effect grants Torataro 1 Strength for that turn, once per kind.
DOHNA_DOHNA_POWER_KIKUCHIYO_INNATE.title: Kikuchiyo · Innate

DOHNA_DOHNA_POWER_KIKUCHIYO_INNATE.smart: After Kikuchiyo performs her first Attack each turn, draw 1 card.
DOHNA_DOHNA_POWER_MEDHICO_INNATE.title: Medhico · Innate

DOHNA_DOHNA_POWER_JOKER_INNATE.title: Joker · Innate

DOHNA_DOHNA_POWER_JOKER_INNATE.smartDesc: Whenever Joker changes position, he gains 2 Vigor.
DOHNA_DOHNA_POWER_ZAPPA_INNATE.title: Zappa · Innate

DOHNA_DOHNA_POWER_KIRAKIRA_INNATE.title: Kirakira · Innate
